meta.description: Self-hosted platform to run your servers and your team from one place.

home.title: Your servers and your team, in one place
home.intro: Deploy apps and databases to your own machines, manage files across every NAS and cloud drive, host game servers, and work together with chat, calls, tasks, calendar, mail and documents.
home.installHint: Run one line on the machine that will host it. Updates and settings are handled from the web interface afterwards.
home.replacesTitle: If you already pay for these
home.replacesIntro: What Polaris replaces, on your own hardware and with one account.
home.lookIntro: Screenshots of the real interface with sample data.

market.title: Marketplace
market.intro: Every app in the catalogue, as the dashboard lists it. Built-in apps come with every install; the rest install with one press.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: The apps that take Polaris beyond the browser tab. Each one connects to your own server.
downloads.noneHint: Nothing has been published for this one. The release page lists it once it is.
downloads.cliHint: Installs the plr command; sign in with plr login --url and your server's address.
downloads.lineHint: Installs it and keeps it up to date. The files below are for installing by hand.

about.extension: Fills sign-in forms from your vault in Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox.
about.streamdeck: Keys for your deploys, calls and soundboard on a Stream Deck or OpenDeck.
about.companion: The same actions for decks driven by Bitfocus Companion.
about.cli: Deploy, read logs and restart from a terminal.
about.desktop: Polaris in its own window on Windows, macOS and Linux.

api.title: API reference
api.intro: Every call an API key can make, generated from the same document each Polaris serves at /api/openapi.json.
